articles.title: Melatonin Supplements Market Projected to Reach USD 13.1 Billion by 2035 amid Surging Global Demand for Natural Sleep Solutions
articles.mainIdea: Melatonin Supplements Market Projected to Reach USD 13.1 Billion by 2035 amid Surging Global Demand for Natural Sleep Solutions
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Melatonin Supplements Market Projected to Reach USD 13.1 Billion by 2035 amid Surging Global Demand for Natural Sleep Solutions. The global melatonin supplements market is entering a decisive "scaling phase," with its valuation projected to grow from USD 3.3 billion in 2025 to USD 13.1 billion by 2035. According to the latest industry outlook, this rapid expansion represents a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 14.9%, fueled by a fundamental shift in consumer behavior toward preventive healthcare and non-prescription sleep aids.
